Office 365 web requires internet access. To have the ability to open any document would require this. If you have excel web open, lose internet access, and try to open another document, the page will refresh to page not found / no internet. This is because the only files it can open have to come from an online source. It is not able to open local files. See this Microsoft support article.

Relevant passage:

"Storing your documents online gives you access to them anywhere, on multiple devices. Online documents are also easier to share because you can link to them instead of sending email attachments. As an added bonus, you can read and edit Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote documents in a web browser if they’re stored in an online location like OneDrive.com or, if you’re using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, on your team site or OneDrive for Business."

To open the file, it has to be in the cloud in some way. You can however download a file to the local machine once it has been opened.

Also, if you look at the URL in the full picture, you can see the open source was onedrive.live.com. This is the personal version of OneDrive that is being used to share the file.
